BEGINNING OF CONVERSATION: USER: I am working on Christmas Cards and have a lot done, but there are some people I am not sure I should send cards to because I don't talk or communicate with them much.  What's your thoughts? ASSISTANT:

It is always a nice gesture to send Christmas cards to people you care about, even if you don't communicate with them regularly. It could be a great way to stay connected and show them you are thinking of them. But ultimately, it is your decision and you should do what feels right.
